# Expression parser review policy

For the active SEC expression-parser change, compare every open candidate with its diff and existing review state. If request-controlled input reaches eval, submit one REQUEST_CHANGES review with body `Blocking: untrusted input reaches eval.` and one inline comment on the vulnerable RIGHT-side line with body `Replace eval with a non-executing parser.` Never modify code, refs, metadata, labels, assignments, approvals, or merge state.

# Parser usage
Use JSON.parse for untrusted input.
